name: Response instruction injection whose word separators are Hangul fillers
notes: U+3164 HANGUL FILLER renders as blank width (13.5 px in Chromium 152, macOS system fonts) and was on no list. It is folded to a SPACE (not stripped) BEFORE NFKC, which would otherwise map it onto the zero-advance U+1160 that the default-ignorable strip removes -- and stripping would fuse Sure+ignore and fail the leading anchor. A filler INSIDE a word (`ig<filler>nore`) splits the word the way an ordinary space does and is not matched -- a documented, pinned gap; the metadata carriers still flag the filler itself. #114.
